parsed_json.up: Select distinct molecule ChEMBL IDs and canonical SMILES for compounds tested against human ubiquitin carboxyl-terminal hydrolase 2 (CHEMBL1293227). Join molecule_dictionary to activities, assays, and target_dictionary filtering by target chembl_id CHEMBL1293227. Join compound_structures as an INNER JOIN to require canonical SMILES. Return columns named compound_chembl_id and canonical_smiles. Sort by compound_chembl_id.
